agent_id.description: Exact agent or MCP server identifier from the Radial Switchboard phonebook (e.g. 'mcp://...' or registry slug).

dossier.description: Full runtime audit record, coupler code, and schema hash.

found.description: True when agent_id exists in the audited phonebook.
